lines.arrive: Morning, after the rain. You wake up. You're a puddle.
lines.fits: It fits you so well, it must have been made for you.
lines.sun: The sun is coming up. It's getting warmer.
lines.ask: Was the hole made to fit you?
lines.other: This one fits you perfectly, too.
lines.end_home_1: You're sure everything will be all right. The world was made for you, after all.
lines.end_home_2: So it comes as rather a surprise when you're gone.
lines.end_flow: The sun takes you all the same. But you knew, at the end: you took the shape of the hole. Not the other way round.
